title: lint: a stored computed field added by an object extension is never judged by the field-formula pass (stored-expression warnings and expression errors skip it)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1T5HEokjRgR6vCBX8

Filing gate: ① product defect (declared ≠ enforced at authoring), a follow-up owed by the work of objectstack#32529 / PR #32858 (contract review 6836331831 should-fix 4, kept out of that PR on purpose).
reach: measured through the built `@objectstack/lint` `validateStackExpressions` — the pass `os validate`, `os build` and the object save door run — at PR #32858 head `89bb0573` (dev report 6837156594): `hours: { type: 'number', expression: 'record.days * record.employee.daily_hours' }` declared on `hr_leave_request` → 1 `stored-expression-cross-record-input`; the same field added through `objectExtensions: [{ extend: 'hr_leave_request', fields: { hours } }]` → 0.
Business reason: an app (or a package extending another package's object) that adds a stored computed field through `objectExtensions` gets no authoring signal at all — not the new stale-value warnings and not the field-formula pass's own errors — while the engine plans and stores that field exactly like a declared one. The author learns nothing until a value is wrong in production. Package-on-package extension is the normal way an add-on adds fields, so this is the path add-on authors (and AI agents writing them) take.
Reader who acts: the `domain:spec` seat dispatches it; the implementer widens `judgeFieldFormula`'s field walk (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, today `fieldList` = the declared objects' fields) to fields an `objectExtensions` entry adds, judged against the extended object as served. Count first-party exposure first (examples, apps, HotCRM) — newly judged errors on extension fields are a narrowing.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue extension judgeFieldFormula` → 4 hits (#32529, #22032 closed, two seat posts), none this gap.

Lands after PR #32858 (it adds the member this widening also reaches).
Blocked-by: #32529
